title: Missing Person Reporting Platform
description: A responsive platform for reporting missing persons, with real-time updates, user accounts and secure cloud storage for reports and photos.
overview: My capstone project at Holy Angel University: a responsive web platform for reporting missing persons.
Built with Vue.js on Firebase, with real-time data, sign-in and cloud storage for report photos.
highlights: Real-time report updates with Firebase so new sightings appear without refreshing.
Sign-in and role-based access so only verified users can edit a report.
End-to-end testing across browsers and phone sizes before submission.
